scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Minimal metrics and interior injectivity for nef adjoints” (preprints/Minimal-metrics-and-interior-injectivity-for-nef-adjoints-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b2a7d738f44a3d34), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 1-2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (H, Θ) be a normal connected projective complex klt pair, with Θ an effective rational divisor. Suppose that DH = KH + Θ is a nef Q-Cartier divisor. For every 1 projective log resolution π : V → H, the rational line bundle N = π∗DH has the following property: every semipositive singular Hermitian metric with minimal singularities on N has Lelong number zero at every point of V . Such a metric exists. Neither KH nor Θ is required to be separately Q-Cartier.
